title: HackZurich 2020
description: Forty hours, one sponsor challenge, and an unconventional remote edition of one of Europe’s largest hackathons.
body: I had the chance to participate in HackZurich 2020, one of Europe’s largest hackathons.
Over roughly forty hours, my team and I built a prototype for one of the sponsor challenges. Because of the COVID-19 pandemic, it was a rather unconventional edition of the event.
